name: animated-questionnaire
title: Animated Questionnaire
description: A step-by-step set of questions with progress.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette. The progress bar, the hover fill and a Primary selected colour take its primary colour.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: contentAnimation
props.label: Content animation
props.description: How one question leaves and the next arrives.

props.name: slideDistance
props.label: Slide distance
props.description: How far questions slide, as a percentage of their own size (width sideways, height up and down). Needs a Slide content animation.

props.name: choiceLayout
props.label: Layout
props.description: Choices as full-width cards, or as a compact list of radio buttons.

props.name: choiceHover
props.label: Choice hover
props.description: Hover effect on a choice: a fade, or a fill that grows down from the top. Needs Layout set to Cards.

props.name: choiceColor
props.label: Selected color
props.description: Background of the selected choice. Needs Layout set to Cards.

props.name: indicatorRounded
props.label: Icon roundness
props.description: Corner radius of the check icon box. Needs Indicator set to Check icon and Icon border on.

props.name: indicatorBorder
props.label: Icon border
props.description: Draws a border around the check icon box. Needs Indicator set to Check icon.

props.name: choiceIndicator
props.label: Indicator
props.description: Mark shown on a chosen option.

props.name: bordered
props.label: Show border
props.description: Draws a border around the whole questionnaire.

props.name: multiple
props.label: Choose multiple
props.description: Lets every question accept more than one answer.

props.name: staggerChoices
props.label: Stagger choices
props.description: Choices appear one after another instead of all at once.

props.name: stagger
props.label: Stagger
props.description: Delay between choices appearing, in seconds. Needs Stagger choices on.

props.name: showProgress
props.label: Show progress
props.description: Shows the question count and a progress bar above the question.

props.name: shortcuts
props.label: Choice keys
props.description: Keyboard keys that pick a choice, shown on each choice.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long a question change takes, in seconds. Not used when Content animation is None.

props.name: bounce
props.label: Bounce
props.description: Springiness of the question change. Only used by the slide and scale animations.
